goal: From the foot of Mt Moon, cross the mountain to Cerulean City.
note: test plan for the east-exit fix; the fossil fight is already done in the save this resumes from, so it is omitted

subgoals.goal_text: Leave the Center and enter Mt Moon (the cave entrance on Route 4).

Leave Mt Moon by its EAST exit and reach Cerulean City. The east exit is on B1F (not B2F): go back up from B2F, cross B1F to its far-east ladder/opening, which puts you on the EASTERN half of Route 4 — then head east to Cerulean. (Route 4's western half, where you entered, is walled off from Cerulean; you cannot get there overland.)

macro_provenance.note: 2026-08-12 PROBE FINDING: ROUTE_4 is ONE map id but two disconnected halves — from the west (entrance) side the east seam is unreachable (reachable=158 cells, east-edge reachable=[]). Mt Moon's only east exit is B1F's LAST_MAP warp at (27,3); 1F's LAST_MAP warps (14/15,35) are the ENTRANCE. The old exit_mt_moon_east ended on {map:ROUTE_4} which BOTH halves satisfy — so it 'succeeded' on the wrong side and reach_cerulean_city could never cross east.
